title: Founders' House Kolkata
description: Kolkata's most relentless national-level 72-hour startup sprint. 10 elite founder squads selected from universities across India live on site at AIC Techno (Offbeat CCU), crack raw mentor problems, build production MVPs, and pitch live to venture syndicates. Organized by Hult Prize at TIU and hosted at the state of the art incubation hub AIC Techno (Offbeat CCU), this is not a sleep deprived gimmick. It is an incubator grade gauntlet for founders who want to build companies that last. NOTE: This is the selection for the first round. Shortlisted teams will come offline and build at OFFBEAT CCU Kolkata for 3 days (18th-20th December). Free of cost. title: DevNexus Vidisha
description: DEVNEXUS is a 6-hour hackathon organized by SATI Coding Club, primarily aimed at university students who are passionate about technology, creativity, and innovation. The event is designed to empower students by providing them with a platform to enhance their technical skills, develop problem-solving abilities, explore emerging technologies, and transform innovative ideas into practical solutions. Through teamwork, collaboration, and hands-on development, participants will get an opportunity to think beyond traditional classroom learning, gain practical experience, and connect with like-minded innovators from different academic backgrounds. DEVNEXUS encourages students to experiment, learn, build, and challenge their creative limits while fostering a culture of innovation, entrepreneurship, and technological advancement. Join us for 6 hours of learning, building, networking, and creating something meaningful. title: ETHChiangmai & Longevity Hackathon 2026
description:
ETHChiangmai & Longevity Hackathon 2026 brings together builders from Web3, AI and Longevity in Chiang Mai on December 26–27. Over two days, teams of 1–4 will build real products for real people, from stablecoin payments used by local merchants to tools that help people sleep, move and live better. PayFi & RWA (3,000 USDT): bring stablecoins and onchain assets into everyday life: payments, crypto cards, merchant acceptance, remittances, real-world assets, and agentic payments.

Longevity (3,000 USDT): an open, product-focused track with no Web3 requirement. Build around movement, sleep, biohacking and peptides, including AI health companions.

Privacy & Data Sovereignty (3,000 USDT): give people real ownership of their data through ZK, FHE, private identity, health data sovereignty and private AI.

Cosmo-Localism (Bonus, 1,000 USDT): build for real users in Southeast Asia. It can be combined with any other track. AI is welcome in every track, and any tech stack is welcome. Whether you’re a developer, designer, researcher or health enthusiast, come build with a global community in one of the world’s favourite cities for digital nomads. title: GeNarrative Clash
description:
Where Generative AI Meets Human Creativity: Kolkata's Ultimate Prompt Engineering Challenge Are you ready to redefine how stories are told, music is composed, and digital art is created? 
GeNarrative Clash
 is Kolkata's premier Prompt Engineering & AI Building Challenge, organized by the GeeksforGeeks Student Chapter at Techno India University. Don't worry if you are new to AI development! Before the live challenge kicks off, every participant gets access to an exclusive 
1-Hour Hands-On Masterclass on AI Development & API Integration
. Learn how to harness cutting-edge LLMs, query GenAI APIs, and leverage rapid prototyping tools so you can build a solid, production-ready product with confidence. Generative AI shouldn't replace human creators, it should supercharge them!

You are free to solve any real-world problem in the artistic or creative domain. title: Clash of Commits
description:
The kingdom is calling. The battlefield is open. Is your clan ready? Clash of Commits
 is not your usual hackathon. It's a clan-based coding battlefield where ideas become weapons, code becomes your arsenal, and only the strongest clans make it to the crown. Gather your squad of 
4-5 members
, bring your boldest ideas, and prepare to battle through three rounds of innovation. Build your base, survive the raid, and fight your way into the Arena Finals! This registration is ONLY for Round 1 – Build Your Base (Online). Registering here does not guarantee participation in the offline rounds. Three rounds. Two Clan Wars. One ultimate champion. Every legendary kingdom starts with a strong foundation. This is where your clan makes its first move. Every submission will be evaluated, and the 
top 120 clans
 will earn their place in the offline battlefield. The shortlisted clans enter campus for an intense 
24-hour building showdown
. Turn your ideas into working solutions, tackle problem statements, collaborate with mentors, and make every second count. Once the code freeze hits, it's time for 
CLAN WAR I
. Judges evaluate every submission based on innovation, technical depth, impact, and execution. Only the 
top 8 clans
 survive the raid and advance to the Arena Finals. Eight clans enter. Only one walks away with the crown. The top 8 clans face off in a knockout pitching bracket. Present your solution, demonstrate what you've built, and convince the judges why your clan deserves the throne. With a live audience, high-stakes presentations, and an audience vote, every pitch matters. The final showdown is the 
CROWN MATCH
 — where the last two contenders battle it out to determine the ultimate champion. Eight tracks. Countless possibilities. Your clan decides what to build. AI & MACHINE LEARNING

Build intelligent agents, develop generative AI applications, explore computer vision, or push the boundaries of predictive models and edge AI. ROBOTICS & IoT

Bring hardware to life with autonomous systems, drones, smart sensors, microcontrollers, embedded intelligence, and connected technologies. WEB & APPLICATIONS

Create powerful full-stack platforms, mobile applications, SaaS products, developer tools, and scalable digital experiences. BLOCKCHAIN & WEB3

Explore decentralised applications, smart contracts, DeFi, DAOs, digital assets, and next-generation decentralised infrastructure. AR, VR & EXTENDED REALITY

Build immersive experiences through augmented reality, virtual reality, mixed reality, spatial computing, and interactive virtual environments. CYBERSECURITY

Challenge vulnerabilities, strengthen digital security, develop threat detection systems, and explore ethical hacking, privacy, and digital forensics. FINTECH & BUSINESS INNOVATION

Reimagine financial services through digital payments, financial intelligence, automation, algorithmic trading, and innovative business solutions. OPEN INNOVATION

No boundaries. No restrictions. Explore HealthTech, ClimateTech, EdTech, Data Science, Smart Cities, or anything beyond the ordinary. Turn your boldest ideas into impactful real-world solutions. Your clan has been formed. Your strategy is ready. Now it's time to enter the battlefield. BUILD YOUR BASE. SURVIVE THE RAID. CONQUER THE ARENA. The battlefield awaits. title: GOA BUILDATHON 27
description:
Every great innovation starts with an idea. What makes it great is the courage to build it, the curiosity to experiment, and the determination to bring it to life. GOA BUILDATHON ’27
 is a 
36-hour, student-run hackathon
 where aspiring technologists, creative thinkers, and problem-solvers come together to turn bold ideas into tangible products. It’s a space to push boundaries, collaborate with like-minded innovators, experiment with emerging technologies, and build something that goes beyond the ordinary. Set against the backdrop of

title: CODERAVE 2.0
description:
CODE • COLLABORATE • INNOVATE - The SLIET Annual  Hackathon. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club

Venue:
 Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab

Mode:
 Hybrid — Online (All India) + Offline (SLIET Campus) Coderave 2.0 is a national-level hybrid hackathon designed to bring together innovative minds, passionate developers, designers, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful technology solutions. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club, this edition offers students an opportunity to demonstrate their creativity, technical expertise, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities through a competitive, time-bound development experience. The hackathon welcomes teams from colleges and universities across India through its online participation track, while SLIET students can participate in the offline campus track. Shortlisted teams will present their ideas through PPT pitches, followed by an intensive 24-hour open-source development challenge in which participants will build, test, and demonstrate their solutions. Whether you are interested in web development, app development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, or other emerging technologies, Coderave 2.0 is your platform to innovate, collaborate, and compete. Round 1 — Registration and PPT Submission:
 The Team Leader registers the complete team and submits the project proposal PPT. Round 2 — PPT Evaluation and Shortlisting:
 Judges evaluate submissions based on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical approach, potential impact, and presentation quality. Round 3 — PPT Pitch:
 Shortlisted online teams(Max 20 team) pitch through an online meeting. Shortlisted SLIET teams pitch offline on campus on 13 February. Round 4 — 24-Hour Open-Source Hackathon:
 Selected teams(Both online and offline track) build their solutions within the official development window. Round 5 — Final Submission and Evaluation:
 Teams submit their working solution, source code repository, demo video, and other required deliverables. Judges evaluate the final projects and announce the winners. The hackathon is an opportunity to turn ideas into functional prototypes within 24 hours. Teams are expected to develop their solutions during the official event window and use open-source tools, libraries, and technologies wherever possible. Participants must maintain a project repository, provide clear documentation, and ensure that their work is demonstrable. Teams must disclose third-party components and follow applicable open-source licences. Previously developed work must be declared, and the core solution must comply with the organizers' originality requirements. Exciting prizes, goodies, certificates, and recognition await outstanding teams. Final awards, prize amounts, sponsor benefits, and certificate eligibility will be announced through the official event communication. Note:
 The dates above are 
tentative
 until officially confirmed. The year, registration deadline, online pitch schedule, and final evaluation schedule will be published by the organizers. title: Health Hackathon 3.0
description:
VIT Bhopal University to Host Health Hackathon 3.0 in January 2027 Event invites new ideas to make healthcare better and cost less VIT Bhopal University will host Health Hackathon 3.0 on 28 and 29 January 2027. A pre-event workshop will take place on 27 January 2027. VIT Bhopal is collaborating with the Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University for this event. Its full title is “Health Hackathon 3.0: Global Health Access Innovation Challenge – Next Generation.” New Ideas for Better Healthcare

The event has a clear aim: it seeks innovative ideas that can improve healthcare accessibility for more people, reduce costs, and enhance overall efficiency. Participants are invited to propose actionable solutions to real-world healthcare challenges. Key focus areas for submissions include:

•	Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery.

•	New ways and platforms to support mental health.

•	Application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare solutions.

•	Tools leveraging health data analytics to identify and predict health risks. A Chance to Share and Build Ideas

Health Hackathon 3.0 invites innovators, students, and researchers to present their concepts and refine them further. The emphasis is on practical, high-impact solutions designed to reach underserved communities and individuals facing healthcare access barriers. Event Overview & Key Dates

• Pre-Event Workshop: 27 January 2027

• Main Hackathon: 28 & 29 January 2027

• Venue: VIT Bhopal University, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh

• Total Prize Pool: ₹2 Lakh Registration & Submission

Team size:2–4 participants

Participation: Free Build real solutions, solve meaningful problems, and create something that works. HAXFINITY is a 24-hour hackathon conducted as part of XTHRON ’27, the annual IT fest of the Department of Computer Science, Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur. Students from different colleges and backgrounds will identify problems, build software prototypes, and present their work to judges. The event includes the opening ceremony, a 21-hour project-building window, demonstrations, judging, and awards. There is no compulsory theme. Teams may choose any problem and build a software solution using any suitable technology. Build a product, tool, or prototype that solves a real problem or explores an idea. Build an application using machine learning, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, data analysis, or another AI-related technology. Build technology that improves people’s lives — for example, in education, healthcare, accessibility, sustainability, financial inclusion, or community welfare. Detailed judging criteria will be published before the event. Building window:*11:00 AM, 3 – 8:00 AM, 4 JANUARY (21 hours). Students from all colleges, streams, and experience levels are welcome. You can participate as a beginner, developer, designer, or creative problem-solver. Interests in AI, cybersecurity, web, mobile, cloud, or social-impact technology are all welcome. Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous)

Santhigramam, Eranhimangad

Nilambur, Malappuram, Kerala — 679329 Check-in and travel details will be shared with registered participants. Opportunity to demo projects to judges

Competition Rules All project-specific development must happen during the official building window. Teams may arrive with an idea, but pre-built projects cannot be submitted. Open-source libraries, APIs, datasets, and templates are allowed, subject to their licences. Teams must disclose pre-existing components and AI tools used. Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools are allowed across all tracks. Teams should submit early; late submissions may not be accepted. A working prototype or meaningful demonstration is expected. Teams must be able to explain their technology, process, third-party components, and contributions. Projects must not violate copyright, privacy, security, or applicable law. Organisers may disqualify entries for plagiarism, misconduct, unsafe content, or rule violations. All participants are expected to maintain a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming environment. Participants can approach the organising team for assistance or to report a concern. title: Code N Mod
description:
Learn the craft. Build the game. Play your creation. Organized by 
32BIT — Game Development Club of Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT), Tumakuru
, this one-day, offline event brings together students interested in gaming, programming, game design, and interactive experiences. The event will begin with an engaging morning session featuring guest speakers, discussions, Q&A, and a practical game-development workshop. Participants will get an opportunity to learn from experienced individuals and explore the process of creating games. In the afternoon, participants will take part in an open-format game-development hackathon. There is no fixed theme, so participants can build any type of game using their preferred game engine, programming language, and tools. Participants can compete individually or form teams of up to six members. Games will be evaluated by judges, with prizes awarded to the top three entries. Whether you are an experienced developer, an aspiring game designer, or someone curious about how games are made, this event is an opportunity to learn, experiment, collaborate, and turn ideas into playable experiences.
